values.name: EI at I=4096, Snied IFLAG=1, DIMEN=2

attempt: Built the unmodified sources with compile lines of our own (the archive's Drivers/Makefile needs a makefile.inc the archive does not ship); no source file edited. Ran TSNIED as shipped. Four passes: gfortran 16.2 -O2 (pass 1, the original attempt), the same repeated (pass 2), gfortran 16.2 -O0 (pass 3), gfortran 13 -O2 (pass 4). All give 0.99994610736637701 at I=4096, against the shipped 0.9999468969847435 at tol_abs 1e-9. Flag probes left the output bit-identical. Cause not isolated: candidates not tested are a different code version of src.f/extra.f, a different word size or compiler, or original-system state. See result.md.

original_attempt.reason: the unmodified sources built with our compile lines and ran to completion (build_exit=0, run_exit=0); the output does not match the shipped reference, which is the mismatch recorded here
